About me

Business meets technology.

I am a Salesforce Business Analyst and Solution Architect with over nine years of Salesforce experience, helping organizations translate business needs into tailored cloud solutions.

My experience spans requirements discovery, solution design, platform configuration, data migration, integrations, testing and user adoption. With a background in business and technology from Seminole State College of Florida, I bring both functional expertise and a practical understanding of technology to complex projects.

I am passionate about continuous learning, innovation and web development, particularly HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Collaboration, respect and social responsibility are central to how I work and contribute to my community.
